text:
incident-bot: AUTOMATED PAGE -> High 5xx rate detected for api.redwood.com (rolling 5m error rate 8.7% > threshold 5%). Trigger: edge->backend 502/524 surge. PagerDuty incident created and paging primary on-call.

pagerduty: PD ALERT: Incident #INC123456 - api.redwood.com high 5xx - page fired to oncall_eu (priority: high) :rotating_light:

oncall_eu: ackd. I'm on it, spinning up terminal. Can someone grab quick customer-impact estimate?

alice_support: getting inbound tickets and a handful of support chats. Affected: EU + some US users behind specific CDNs. Customers reporting 502s and TLS handshake failures in traces.

sara_eng: I'm seeing a spike in TLS handshake errors on the frontend logs: "tls: handshake failure" followed by upstream 502s. Timeline matches the PD alert. Traces indicate a subset of edge nodes are routing to a legacy target group with an expired backend cert.

mike_netops: Running quick check on ALB -> target group health:```bash
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/tg-legacy
```Results: 60% of targets Unhealthy (TLS mismatch). New target group (tg-current) healthy. But traffic affinity still sending ~30% to tg-legacy due to weight config/route table propagation.

ryan_sre: If it's a weight mismatch, we can temporarily reroute all traffic off tg-legacy. I'll prepare a one-liner to force 100/0 weights and start connection-drain:```bash
# set weights
aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:... --default-actions '[{"Type":"forward","ForwardConfig":{"TargetGroups":[{"TargetGroupArn":"arn:.../tg-current","Weight":100},{"TargetGroupArn":"arn:.../tg-legacy","Weight":0}]}}]'
```
I'll coordinate with deploy-bot for the change.

deploy-bot: deploy change queued to apply to LB config. ETA ~40s. Will post status when done.

oncall_eu: Before we flip weights, can we confirm no ongoing deploys that depend on tg-legacy? @sara_eng any active canaries?

sara_eng: No active canaries. Canary finished ~2h ago. Safe to move.

deploy-bot: LB config change applied. Returning success.

mike_netops: Confirming TCP connections: tg-legacy connections dropping, active connections finishing, new connections go to tg-current. Health checks show Unhealthy->unused.

ryan_sre: Observability update: 5xx rate dropped from 8.7% -> 1.2% within 90s of change. TLS handshake error logs correlate down to near baseline. Nice.

alice_support: Updating customers: posting to status page that partial errors affecting EU traffic were mitigated; followup with root cause in ~2h.

oncall_eu: Paging cadence: we'll keep incident open for 2 hours for monitoring and for PD handoff if it resurfaces. @pagerduty can you pause further escalations for this incident?

pagerduty: Acknowledged. Incident in acknowledged state; alert suppression for next 2h.

sara_eng: Quick root-cause notes: Legacy backend cert expired unexpectedly; automation that rotates backend certs failed due to RBAC token expiration on the cert-rotation job. Rotation job shows 403 at 03:12 UTC. We'll open a followup with infra to fix token refresh and add an alert for cert-rotation 403s.

ryan_sre: Action items assigned: 1) infra: fix rotation job token refresh; 2) infra: audit cert expiry alerting (add 14d/7d/1d alarms); 3) eng: add LB route weighting health check to avoid mid-roll traffic to legacy groups.

alice_support: Customer msg draft for status page (pt1): "We experienced elevated 5xx errors impacting some EU customers between 03:10-03:15 UTC. Traffic has been routed away from the affected backend and service has returned to normal for most users. We're investigating root cause and will post an update." Anyone want to tweak?

sara_eng: LGTM. Add note about limited subset of paths: /v1/generate endpoints mostly.

mike_netops: Postmortem will include timeline, LB config change, and mitigation commands used. I'll attach ALB metrics and describe-target-health outputs.

oncall_eu: Closing loop: monitoring for 30 more mins, then I hand to morning oncall if stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
